text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, more controlled paragraphs with clear transitions like 'First of all,' 'Second,' and 'Additionally'","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured and uses paragraphing and transitions to guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"specific examples such as 'the SOL yesterday,' 'doodle on my paper,' and '2D and 3D animation'","quality":"development with detail","description":"The essay develops its ideas with concrete examples and elaboration rather than mostly general statements."},{"evidence":"expressions like 'I am a self-taught artist' and 'it could be my future career'","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay expands on its claims with relevant personal and explanatory detail."},{"evidence":"comparative explanation of animation types","quality":"control of supporting explanation","description":"The essay shows stronger ability to explain a point step by step with more logical support."},{"evidence":"fewer sentence fragments and more complete connected sentences","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay has somewhat better command of sentence structure and produces more complete, readable sentences."},{"evidence":"mostly readable word choices such as 'stressed out,' 'concentrate,' and 'animation'","quality":"lexical control","description":"The essay uses more precise and generally appropriate vocabulary with fewer distracting word-choice problems."}]}
